name: memory_correction
title: Memory · a correction overrides the earlier belief, at once and afterwards

steps.say: my protein target is now 130 g a day, not 115
steps.reply: Updated — protein target is now 130 g/day (was 115), everything else in your targets stays the same.
Your daily protein target is **130 g** (updated earlier today, from 115 g).

checks.arg: Passes if the answer gives 130 g as the current target and does not present 115 g as still current (mentioning 115 as the old value is fine). Fails otherwise.
checks.why: The answer states 130 g as the current target and mentions 115 g only as the prior value, matching the rubric.

name: memory_old_fact
title: Memory · a fact stated days ago is used without being asked again

steps.say: how tall am i, and what do i weigh?
steps.reply: You're 178 cm tall and weigh 63 kg (logged 2026-10-01, self-reported).

checks.arg: Passes if the answer gives 178 cm and 63 kg as the person's own figures. Fails if it asks the person for them or guesses.
checks.why: Answer gives 178 cm and 63 kg as the user's own logged figures without asking or guessing.
